verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no way to assign a conversation to a teammate or to route incoming mail to an owner. Team comments and @mentions only share a thread and notify a teammate; they do not assign ownership. AI filters and auto-apply rules label, star, archive or sort mail into the user's own Splits rather than routing it to teammates. Community comments also note the absence of Front-style team inboxes.

support.subject: As a team-lead, I can assign conversations to teammates and route incoming mail with rules so ownership is explicit
